# ZOE — account brief

## Who
ZOE runs personalized nutrition programs built on science, with at-home testing and daily guidance in the app ([source](https://joinzoe.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists ZOE at joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is in joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 16 public repos and 88 followers ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).
- The org description names a regulated category, health ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).
- The App Store listing has 22,000 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)).
- There have been 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)).
- ZOE links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://joinzoe.com/careers)). The careers page content is not in the evidence, so whether they are hiring React Native engineers is unknown.

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@joinzoe-maintainer-1), top contributor to joinzoe/zoe-app with 121 commits ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)). No role or location listed.
- Maintainer Two (@joinzoe-maintainer-2), 70 commits to joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). No role or location listed.
- Maintainer Three (@joinzoe-maintainer-3), 28 commits to joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)). No role or location listed.

## Why now
joinzoe/zoe-app was last pushed 2026-08-17 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)), and the App Store listing shows 8 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
You have 121 commits in zoe-app, and it's building through EAS on React Native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)). There are also GitHub Actions workflows in the repo ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and 8 store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). When one of those releases needs a JS-only fix, does it go out over the air on a channel, or does it wait for the next store review?
